integrity: Exact symbolic enumeration with reproducible source code; finite-field checks corroborate and do not replace the general proof. No independent audit.
scientific_limitations: For the specified rational integral Klein quartic only; no claims at characteristic 2 or 7, for twists, or for rational points of tangency. Prime counts rely on a cyclotomic Galois and finite reduction proof. Previously published complex incidence, automorphism orbit and four-real-bitangent facts are excluded from novelty. An unindexed historical calculation might overlap.
title: The seventh-cyclotomic Galois spectrum of the Klein quartic bitangents
